topic: shared mutable state — module-level singleton accumulating across tests
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: Mutable default arguments in Python — e.g., `roles=[]` in `User.__init__`. Python evaluates default values once at function definition time, so the same list object is shared across all calls that use the default, causing unintended state bleed between instances.
